[[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]]5 (Explosion) |speed = 4 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Missile APC''' ('''Armored Personnel Carrier''') is a unit spawned by the [[Commander]]'s ''Support Caravan'' ability. One spawns with each ability use, with it being in the middle of the caravan. The ability itself has a 60 second cooldown and costs {{Money|2,000}} to use. The '''Missile APC''' fires missiles at enemies in a burst. As with other units, the '''Missile APC''' started from the path's exit and moved towards the entrance. It can detect hidden enemies. ==Appearance== The '''Missile APC''' is a khaki-colored and typical in appearance to other APCs in real life. It has six lights on the front and multiple hatches.
